name: mac-coding-agent
description: 24/7 Mac OS coding agent powered by open-source and local models

scripts.dev: concurrently -n agent,web -c teal,blue "npm run dev -w agent" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w agent && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -n agent,web -c teal,blue "npm run start -w agent" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w agent && npm run test -w web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w agent && npm run test:unit -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w agent && npm run lint -w web
